messages:
jamie: noticing a surge of fncall validation rejects on the new function-invoke streaming path. console shows spikes concentrated on partner routes.

rachel: any samples? quick link?

jamie: https://console.redwood.internal/d/validation?panel=fncall_rejects 

ian: pulled a few. common theme: function output contains explicit nulls for non-required fields and also sometimes returns an array where we expect an object. validator flags `type_mismatch` and `unexpected_null`. example below.

```
# validator error
{"path":"$.result.items","error":"type_mismatch","expected":"object","actual":"array"}

# model output (streamed)
{"result":{"items":[{"id":1}]}}
```

jamie: looks like streaming fragments are being validated before our output coercion layer runs (the coercer flattens singletons and converts []->{} when legacy adapters need it). so post-process never hits for some streams.

rachel: can we tag validation events with `validated_stage` = "pre_coercion" | "post_coercion" so console can split this quickly? also sample the rejected payloads for route `/partner/orders`.

ian: agreed. i'll land a tiny telemetry change and add `adapter_applied` boolean. will also add a unit test for chunked frames to ensure coercion runs.

infra-bot: opened PR 5610 by ian: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/PR/5610 (streaming coercion + telemetry tag).

jamie: mitigation: apply route-level override to switch gating to SOFT for /partner/* until PR lands. ops?

infra-bot: override applied: shape-gate-canary /partner/* -> SOFT at 2026-03-24T09:12Z by ops-team.

rachel: thanks. once PR lands we should replay sampled rejects through post-coercion pipeline and update dashboard tile showing pre vs post coercion rejects. if post_coercion rejects are low, re-enable strict gating.

ian: will request reviewers, ETA ~2h.
